metadata.description: Top Level Cyber Threat Clusters (TLCTC) — cause-oriented, axiomatic cyber threat taxonomy as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: tlctc
plugins.description: Teaches Claude the full TLCTC v2.3 framework — 10 axioms, 10 threat clusters, R-* classification rules, attack-path notation (Δt velocity, ||...||, ⇒, |...|, ?/…), and worked examples — so any session can classify incidents, CVEs, and threat intel through a causal, axiomatic lens.
